steps.name: fast_unit_suite
steps.description: Run the full local automated suite.

steps.name: validation_manifest
steps.description: Write the current readiness index and not-live-ready report.

steps.name: performance_profile
steps.description: Run critical-path benchmark tasks and budget checks.

steps.name: paper_dry_run
steps.command: trading_env\Scripts\python.exe main.py paper-session --provider sample --symbol SPY --store-dir runs/release-paper-dry-run --timeout-seconds 60

steps.name: paper_profile_validation
steps.description: Review paper-profile validation evidence in the release bundle.

steps.name: alpaca_micro_notional_submit
steps.command: trading_env\Scripts\python.exe main.py paper-session --provider alpaca --execution-mode paper --paper-profile micro-notional --symbol SPY --store-dir runs/release-alpaca-micro --timeout-seconds 180
steps.description: Optional broker-backed micro-notional paper proof when credentials and market conditions are available.

steps.name: deployment_rehearsal
steps.description: Manual/deployment environment rehearsal until automated deployment runners exist.
